nodes.description: Address of the contract owner, set in the owned constructor and updated by transferOwnership.
Mapping from player number to the address that enrolled at that slot.
uint8 counter tracking how many players have enrolled, also used as modulus source.
LotteryState enum controlling whether enrollment is open or finished.
uint8 maximum number of players, initialized to 55.
Minimum ether value required to enroll, initialized to 20000000000000000 wei.
Constructor of the owned base contract; records msg.sender as owner.
Owner-only function that transfers ownership to newOwner.
Constructor of the lottery contract; sets state to Accepting.
Payable enrollment function that validates state and value, increments number, and registers msg.sender.
Owner-only setter for the maxnumber state variable.
Owner-only setter for the minAmount state variable.
View helper returning the current number and the address stored at that slot.
Owner-only function that derives a winning number and distributes funds.
Owner-only function that deletes player entries and resets number and state.
Private function that sends one tenth of the balance to the owner and the remainder to the winning player.
Internal pseudo-random generator using block.timestamp and player mapping as entropy.
Caller supplied address used for ownership assignment, access checks and player registration.
Miner-influenced timestamp used as the entropy source for winner selection.
Assignment owner = newOwner; privileged state mutation guarded only by msg.sender equality.
owner.transfer(this.balance/10); external ether transfer executed before later balance reads.
players[winningNumber].transfer(this.balance); external ether transfer to an attacker-controlled address.
number += 1; uint8 increment subject to overflow limitations and state desynchronization.
keccak256(block.timestamp) % number; predictable timestamp-derived randomness.
Parameter of transferOwnership receiving the new owner address.
Parameter of setMaxNumber receiving the new maximum player value.
Parameter of setMinAmount receiving the new minimum ether value.
Parameter of distributeFunds identifying the slot to be paid.
Local variable in randomtest holding the first modulo result.
Local variable in determineWinner holding the value returned by randomtest.
Loop counter used by startOver to delete player entries.
Named return value of lastPlayer holding the player address.
Named return value of lastPlayer holding the current player number.

edges.reason: msg.sender from the constructor is stored into the owner state variable.
The owned constructor writes the caller-derived address into owner.
transferOwnership authorizes the caller through require(msg.sender == owner).
newOwner parameter is written directly into the privileged owner variable.
The owner assignment mutates the owner state variable.
msg.sender is used inside enroll to index the players mapping.
enroll writes the caller address into players[number].
enroll executes the number += 1 increment before the maxnumber check.
The increment operation modifies the number state variable.
enroll sets state to Finished when the player limit is reached.
newNumber parameter feeds the setMaxNumber owner-only setter.
setMaxNumber writes the new value into the maxnumber state variable.
newAmount parameter feeds the setMinAmount owner-only setter.
setMinAmount writes the new value into the minAmount state variable.
determineWinner calls randomtest to obtain the winning number.
block.timestamp is hashed to derive the pseudo-random value.
The timestamp-derived value is returned from randomtest.
determineWinner invokes distributeFunds with the computed winning number.
winningNumber parameter is used to index the players mapping in distributeFunds.
distributeFunds reads players[winningNumber] to determine the transfer recipient.
distributeFunds performs the owner balance transfer.
distributeFunds performs an external transfer to an untrusted player address.
The external transfer to the player can re-enter distributeFunds through a fallback before state is settled.
The owner transfer executes an external call before the remaining balance is sent to the player.
startOver clears entries from the players mapping.
startOver resets the number state variable to zero.
startOver resets the state back to Accepting.
The loop counter drives the deletion loop inside startOver.
lastPlayer reads the player address from the players mapping.
lastPlayer reads the current number state variable.
number is used as the modulus divisor in the random test computation.
The MMaker constructor initializes the state variable to Accepting.
enroll compares number against maxnumber via require, coupling the counter to the configured limit.

normalization_plan.reason: newOwner is a parameter only used to perform the privileged owner assignment inside transferOwnership.
newNumber is a parameter only used to set the maxnumber state variable in setMaxNumber.
newAmount is a parameter only used to set the minAmount state variable in setMinAmount.
winningNumber is a parameter only used to index players and drive the payout in distributeFunds.
inter is a transient local capturing the first keccak modulo result inside randomtest.
winningNumber_local is a transient local holding randomtest output inside determineWinner.
loop_i is the iteration variable of the deletion loop in startOver.
_Player is a named return variable populated from players in lastPlayer.
_number is a named return variable populated from number in lastPlayer.
